{{Top|leg}}
The '''aquatic environment computer''' was a specialized [[Computer/Legends|computer]] produced by the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. Specifically designed for use in liquid environments, they used rare mineral elements found in [[Dac/Legends|Dac's]] [[Ocean/Legends|seas]] that interacted with the [[Salt/Legends|salinity]] in the water to provide power. [[Kee-Piru Computronics]] manufactured the [[ACCA-1dx000]] aquatic environment computer.
